description: Re-solve the R7-D7B Level-B refined frozen-halo fixed point, extract q-specific viability thresholds at all 16 certified centers, construct exact-rational midpoint distance witnesses, and prove certificate-backed finite-abstraction kernel set separation using the independently checked R7-D8 outward lower bounds.
